note: `command` is a closed set — a renderer must never show an administrator an offline change it cannot name.
`dids` must not be empty — an offline write that changed nobody's access needs no acknowledgement, and an empty list hides who it changed.
`host` is required — where an operator held access is the one fact the record can always state.
